scripts.build: nx run-many -t build -p app web docs reltide-api reltide-worker
scripts.typecheck: nx run-many -t typecheck -p app web docs
scripts.ci:affected: pnpm check && pnpm test && nx affected -t build,typecheck,check-contract,check-links,smoke --exclude=stripe-payment-intent-before,stripe-payment-intent-after --parallel=1 --nxBail
scripts.ci:frontend: pnpm check && pnpm test && nx run-many -t build,typecheck,check-contract,check-links,smoke --exclude=stripe-payment-intent-before,stripe-payment-intent-after --parallel=1 --nxBail --skipNxCache
scripts.ci:config: docker build --tag reltide-ci-config tools/ci && docker run --rm --volume "$PWD:/workspace:ro" reltide-ci-config
scripts.ci:release: pnpm ci:config && pnpm ci:frontend && pnpm rust:ci:default && pnpm rust:ci:no-default-features && pnpm rust:ci:all-features
scripts.rust:ci:default: cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace --locked && cargo build --workspace --all-targets --release --locked
scripts.rust:ci:no-default-features: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked --no-default-features -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace --locked --no-default-features && cargo build --workspace --all-targets --release --locked --no-default-features
scripts.rust:ci:all-features: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked --all-features -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace --locked --all-features && cargo build --workspace --all-targets --release --locked --all-features
scripts.rust:check: cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace --locked && pnpm test:rust-graph
